For more information, see Use the Microsoft Defender portal to configure user reported
settings.
If you’re using a third-party email reporting tool, review Options for third-party reporting tools
and view your vendor’s options to integrate reported messages with Microsoft Defender XDR.
The Phishing Triage Agent addresses phishing incidents that include alerts with the type Email
reported by user as malware or phish. Ensure that you have the corresponding alert policy
enabled. See Alert policies in the Microsoft Defender portal for more information.
